criteria.requirement: The control normalizes wrapper elements,quotes and entity text;its second serialization matches the first but neither preserves the input bytes. Freeze parser/builder/serializer options and compare intended DOM/text invariants,plus idempotence over a relevant malformed/Unicode/table corpus. Preserve raw source and errors separately. One successful control is not proof of general losslessness,HTML validity or safe rendering.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
